evidenceLevels.A: Direct result evidence: externally observable system state, real SQLite state, process/HTTP state, or a real boundary relevant to the claim.
evidenceLevels.B: Process evidence: structured audit, logs, request correlation, or lifecycle trace.
evidenceLevels.C: Simulation evidence: mock, fake clock, fake runtime, stub transport, or isolated deterministic substitute.

invariants.statement: Dynamic Investigation Evidence belongs to the current EvidenceJob generation and must not trigger another automatic Investigation.
Only deterministic Evidence requeue advances EvidenceJob.generation and permits one new automatic Investigation generation.
SUBMITTED and RUNNING InvestigationSessions become FAILED after the stale timeout and retry remains bounded by maxAttempts.
Completed deterministic Evidence with no successful Investigation is reconciled after restart without duplicating an already completed generation.
External-runtime mode has one authoritative reasoning result path and does not create a parallel legacy local reasoning result.
